method: Explicit topical phrases earn 3 points in the title and 1 in the first 480 characters of the normalized Grants.gov synopsis. If no synopsis is available, only the title contributes. Each field earns points once per bed. The matching phrases below are case-insensitive, whole-word regular expressions, with case-sensitive exceptions for the listed title abbreviations. Named synopsis context is excluded without moving the 480-character boundary. Example-list tails are excluded. Highest score wins. The listed title tie order resolves equal title scores. Synopsis-only ties and records with no match go to Other opportunities. The original six beds and the ten beds added in the first split keep their display order. The second split appends topics supported by at least 10 of the 262 previously residual records. Records within each bed are sorted by descending gap score, ascending deadline with rolling last, then opportunity ID.
